source.label: Native Resilience / NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6
source.release: NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 v2.0 (2025), Native annual metric version 1
source.member_lineage_note: Realization IDs and calendar names are not supplied by the annual member table.

limitations: Source area is a statistical or administrative climate support, not a statement of sovereign territory.
Approximately 25 km NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 source resolution does not imply local detail for small areas.
Annual tables omit realization IDs and calendar names; these are unknown, not inferred.
Provider annual metrics ignore missing daily values; n_days counts rows, not valid observations. Daily valid-cell/day coverage is not supplied.
Equal-weight model spread is descriptive, not a confidence interval or scenario probability.
Annual pathways retain simulated interannual variability and are not year-specific weather forecasts.

temp_mean.label: Annual mean temperature
temp_mean.definition: Change in annual mean temperature relative to each model’s 1995–2014 mean.
temp_mean.spread: 10th–90th percentile of equal-weight model changes after each model baseline is subtracted
temp_mean.provider_fit_status_reason: annual member values; no smoothing fit used

pr_annual.label: Annual precipitation
pr_annual.definition: Change in mean annual precipitation total relative to each model’s 1995–2014 mean; millimetres per year.
pr_annual.spread: 10th–90th percentile of equal-weight model changes after each model baseline is subtracted
pr_annual.provider_fit_status_reason: annual member values; no smoothing fit used

spread: the 10th–90th percentile of paired model changes, with equal model weights
